title: 第8章 离去第9章 鼩鼱第10章 牛犬蚁
slug: 重生之为蚁第816章未知岛屿
content_zh:
“殿下，臣想退出蚁族，出去闯荡一番。”
孙云早就有心里准备了，再次跪下，直接说道！
孙云并不怕蚁后会怎样，因为现在的蚁族，没有能留住他的存在。这也是为什么，他把自己部队躲起来的原因，那是孙云最后的底牌。
“退出，你可想好？”蚁后没有生气，反而兴奋道。
现在的孙云，已经超出了蚁后的掌控，蚁后心里一直有危机感。孙云主动要求退出，对于蚁后来说，绝对是好事。
蚂蚁，主要是靠庞大的数量，生存在世界上的。孙云虽然有些实力，但毕竟没有新生蚁补充，没有庞大的数量，蚁后并不认为孙云能在外面生存多久。
“是的殿下！”孙云认真的回答。
孙云能提出来，自然是考虑周全了，这事他早有打算。
蚁后假装有些悲痛的思考，最后咬牙决定道：“好，既然你去意已决，我准了！就把你的军团赏你，再赏你守卫兵十万和一些食物。”
雷霆军团蚁后指挥不动，还不如做个顺水蚁情。至于十万守卫兵，蚁后是想把那些严重的伤残、油尽灯枯的老兵推出去。
“殿下，臣虽然没得到成年彩翼鸟，但那位蟒蛇大人，也给臣留了两只幼鸟尸体。臣斗胆看过，幼鸟出生就已有异兽晶核，肉质绝对不错。臣走后，对殿下必然比较牵挂，想把幼鸟尸体献于殿下。这样的话，殿下就可以有一些飞蚁护卫，殿下的安全问题，才能让臣多一丝安心。再者，臣有何德何能，再要殿下的战士。臣恳请殿下，把十万战士换成十万幼蚁，还请殿下恩准。”孙云大义凛然道！
孙云嘴上说的好听，但两只幼鸟尸体，全都没有拿出来。意思很明显了，就是要用是用幼蚁来换，让蚁后没有拒绝的机会。
蚁后虽强，但没有跟孙云反目的胆量。
“十万幼蚁，这……这……”
蚁后心中窃喜，但还是假装为难的样子！
飞行异兽肉，还真能让蚂蚁有机会，进化成飞行蚁。飞行蚁的战斗力，自然比普通的蚁兵强，绝对蚂蚁中的战斗蚁。
“殿下，臣可以等，要么再过几年再……”
要论演戏，孙云自然比蚁后专业。
“不，将军为我族也立下汗马功劳，这些问题殿下理应满足你，左护卫前去全力配合将军。”蚁后一听，赶紧出言答应。
同时，又怕孙云反悔，直接派近身护卫去执行。开玩笑了，等几年，再等几年孙云就更强大了。现在都拿孙云没办法了，再等几年蚁后就疯了，睡觉都会不安稳的。

“将军请！”
左护卫自然知道蚁后的心思，会意的跑下去！
“谢殿下，那臣告辞了。”
目的达到了，孙云慢慢退出大殿！
content_en:
"Your Highness, I want to quit the ant clan and go out for a while."
Sun Yun had already been mentally prepared. He knelt down again and said directly!
Sun Yun is not afraid of what will happen to the ant queen, because the current ant clan cannot retain his existence. This is also the reason why he hid his troops. That was Sun Yun's last trump card.
"Have you thought about quitting?" The queen ant said excitedly instead of angry.
Sun Yun is now beyond the control of the queen ant, and the queen has always had a sense of crisis in her heart. Sun Yun took the initiative to withdraw, which is definitely a good thing for the ant queen.
Ants survive in the world mainly by their huge numbers. Although Sun Yun has some strength, after all, there are no new ants to supplement him, and there is not a huge number. The ant queen does not think that Sun Yun can survive outside for long.
"Yes, Your Highness!" Sun Yun replied seriously.
Sun Yunneng brought it up, so he had naturally considered it carefully. He had already planned this matter.
The Queen Ant pretended to be thinking sadly, and finally gritted her teeth and decided: "Okay, since you have decided to go, I am sure! I will reward you with your legion, and reward you with 100,000 guards and some food."
The Queen Ant of the Thunder Legion can't command it, so she might as well just be a smooth ant. As for the 100,000 guards, the Queen Ant wanted to push out the severely disabled and exhausted veterans.
"Your Highness, although I did not get the adult colored-winged bird, the python master also left two baby bird corpses for me. I boldly took a look and found that the baby birds were born with alien crystal nuclei, and the meat quality is definitely good. After I left, I must be more concerned about Your Highness, and want to offer the baby bird corpses to His Highness. This In this case, His Highness can be guarded by some flying ants, and His Highness's safety will give me more peace of mind. Furthermore, no matter how virtuous or talented I am, I need your Highness's warriors. I beg your Highness to exchange one hundred thousand soldiers for one hundred thousand young ants, and please give me your permission!"
Sun Yun said it nicely, but the bodies of the two young birds were not taken out. The meaning is obvious, it is to be exchanged for young ants, so that the queen ant has no chance to refuse.
Although the queen ant is strong, she does not have the courage to turn against Sun Yun.
"One hundred thousand young ants, this...this..."
The queen ant was secretly happy, but she still pretended to be embarrassed!
The meat of flying alien animals can really give ants a chance to evolve into flying ants. The combat effectiveness of flying ants is naturally stronger than that of ordinary ant soldiers, and they are definitely the fighting ants among ants.
"Your Highness, I can wait, or wait a few years..."
When it comes to acting, Sun Yun is naturally more professional than the Ant Queen.
"No, the general has made great contributions to our clan. His Highness should satisfy you with these issues. Guard Zuo will go and cooperate with the general fully." Upon hearing this, the Queen Ant quickly agreed.
At the same time, he was afraid that Sun Yun would regret it, so he directly sent close guards to execute it. Just kidding, wait a few years, and Sun Yun will be even stronger in a few more years. There is nothing that can be done to Sun Yun now. In a few years, the queen will go crazy and will not be able to sleep peacefully.
"General please!"
Zuo Wei naturally knew what the ant queen was thinking and ran down knowingly!
"Thank you, Your Highness, I will take my leave."
Having achieved his goal, Sun Yun slowly exited the hall!
